projects.name: dsh-billing

projects.sourceCompatibilityNote: Typechecked and tested against Harness 0.2.1-alpha.3. Peer ranges also accept 0.2.0-rc.2, 0.1.5-rc.2, and 0.1.1-rc.2.

experimentalDownloads.requires: A Windows PC already running DeepSeek Harness on a trusted private network

community.name: mattpocock-skills-dsh
community.description: Matt Pocock's skills for DeepSeek Harness: grilling, writing-for-agents, wait-what, TDD and more — 25 skills adapted from mattpocock/skills (MIT).
community.descriptionZh: Matt Pocock 技能集 DSH 适配版：grilling、writing-for-agents、wait-what、TDD 等 25 个技能（改编自 mattpocock/skills）。
community.manifestNote: Ships dsh.plugin.json; registers no HTTP channels; declares engines.dsh >= 0.1.0-rc.6.

community.name: dsh-ponytail-skills
community.description: Ponytail, lazy senior dev mode, for DeepSeek Harness: 6 skills (ponytail, ponytail-audit, ponytail-debt, ponytail-gain, ponytail-help, ponytail-review) adapted from DietrichGebert/ponytail (MIT).
community.descriptionZh: Ponytail「资深懒人模式」：ponytail、audit、debt、gain、help、review 共 6 个技能（改编自 DietrichGebert/ponytail）。
community.manifestNote: Ships dsh.plugin.json; registers no HTTP channels; declares engines.dsh >= 0.1.0-rc.6.

community.name: dsh-ecc-skills
community.description: ECC (227k-star operator system) skills for DeepSeek Harness — progressive port of 274 curated single-file skills (agentic engineering, evaluation, testing, patterns, vertical domains, docs), adapted from affaan-m/ECC (MIT).
community.descriptionZh: ECC 运营体系技能渐进移植：274 个精选单文件技能，覆盖智能体工程、评估、测试、模式、垂直领域与文档（改编自 affaan-m/ECC）。
community.manifestNote: Ships dsh.plugin.json; registers no HTTP channels; declares engines.dsh >= 0.1.0-rc.6.

community.name: mattpocock-skills-dsh-zh
community.description: Chinese translation of the full promoted mattpocock/skills set for DeepSeek Harness: all 25 skills (grilling, writing-for-agents, wait-what, TDD, code-review and more) translated for the Cordis plugin architecture (MIT, (c) Matt Pocock).
community.descriptionZh: Matt Pocock 技能中文版：25 个技能（grilling、writing-for-agents、wait-what、TDD、code-review 等）正文全部译为中文，适配 DSH 的 Cordis 插件架构。
community.manifestNote: Ships dsh.plugin.json; registers no HTTP channels; declares engines.dsh >= 0.1.0-rc.6.

community.name: dsh-repo-setup
community.description: Repo bootstrap guidance for DeepSeek Harness: a read-only repo_setup_scan tool that detects stack, tests, docs, git, and db, then recommends skill plugins, MCP servers, and hygiene files to install (claude-code-setup counterpart).
community.descriptionZh: 仓库引导工具：只读 repo_setup_scan 检测技术栈、测试、文档、Git 与数据库，并推荐可安装的技能插件、MCP 服务器与卫生文件（claude-code-setup 的 DSH 对应版本）。
community.manifestNote: Ships dsh.plugin.json; registers no HTTP channels; declares engines.dsh >= 0.1.0-rc.6.

community.name: dsh-agent-frugality
community.description: Multi-agent frugality defense plugin: read-ledger dedup, compaction-immune rules with a completion gate, and a cheap-review lane. Zero external dependencies, works on injection.
community.descriptionZh: 多智能体节流防御插件：读取台账去重、免疫压缩规则区与完成机械门禁、低成本审查 lane。零外部依赖，注入即用。
community.manifestNote: Ships dsh.plugin.json; registers no HTTP channels; declares engines.dsh >= 0.1.0-rc.6; npm channel also available via npm install.

community.name: dsh-design-audit
community.description: UI/UX audit-and-fix loop for DeepSeek Harness: headless Chrome evidence, deterministic criteria (WCAG 2.2 / platform guidelines), paste-ready CSS fixes, and re-test delta verification.
community.descriptionZh: DeepSeek Harness 的 UI/UX 审查与优化闭环：无头 Chrome 取证、确定性判据（WCAG 2.2 / 平台指南）、可粘贴 CSS 修复与复测差值验证。
community.manifestNote: Ships a cordis.patch.yml bundle patch declaring dsh.bundle.patch; source repository is not public yet.

community.name: dsh-super-injector
community.description: Host-plane injector that hot-loads any local DeepSeek Harness plugin package at runtime (junction link + loader.create), with hot reload, staged promote, one-click uninject, route self-heal, and a plugin manager UI.
community.descriptionZh: 宿主平面注入器：运行时热注入任意本地 Harness 插件包（junction 链接 + loader.create），支持热重载、侧挂转正、一键卸载、路由自愈与插件管理界面。
community.install: git clone https://github.com/gongyijie85/dsh-super-injector.git (source-only; follow the repository README)
community.manifestNote: Source-only, not published to npm; the repository README is the single source of truth for usage.

community.name: dsh-memory-plus
community.description: Community memory plugin suite: CJK-aware session search with lexical and vector hybrid recall, tool-result dedup, durable workspace facts, pinned user rules, and provenance-tracked native Markdown skills.
community.descriptionZh: 社区记忆插件集：中文与扩展汉字全文检索、词法与向量混合召回、工具结果去重、workspace 持久事实、用户固定规则与带来源记录的原生 Markdown 技能。
community.manifestNote: Meta bundle packages/dsh-memory-bundle declares dsh.bundle.patch with cordis.patch.yml; not published to npm. Submitter-verified against DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 on Linux (119 automated tests, 8 package checks, install / real retrieval / cold restart); Windows and macOS desktop shells are not yet community-verified.
